'''Jon Woodland Holo-Assault''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jon Woodland]]
* '''Published:''' April 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Holotable|ANH-D-imperialholotable.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Holo-Assault
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PHoth Holo-Assault Woodland DS 1997.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Everyone agrees that character selection is a very important component of deck design. Well, here is a Dark side deck with NO characters at all. No this is not a joke deck! It can actually beat a strong light side deck. It all depends on how long it take your opponent to figure out what you are doing...

== Strategy ==

Weaknesses: This deck can be devastated in several ways. First of all, Grimtaash will devastate you if used as a Lost interrupt. Secondly, once your opponent catches on, he/she can put Chewie (or any character boosted to a power of 6 or more) alone at a location and only force drain you there. You will then slowly loose the game. But hey, its fun to try.
